task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

plans.R1:
Based on the image and the task requirements, here's a plan for setting up a comfortable space for someone with the flu:

### [0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the mug with water from the tap. (r1_s2)

### [5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up a tea bag from the cabinet. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the tea bag in the mug. (r1_s4)

### [10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Use the kettle to boil water. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pour hot water into the mug to make tea. (r1_s6)

### [15-20 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug of tea to another robot for delivery to the resting area. (r1_s7)

This plan ensures that the person has a warm drink, which is comforting and helps with hydration.
